# Mr Md Zaker Ullah FRCS, Consultant Oncoplastic Breast Surgeon, London and Essex

> Consultant oncoplastic breast and general surgeon in London and Essex. Clinical Lead of the Breast Unit at Whipps Cross University Hospital, Barts Health NHS Trust. Private practice at Bupa Wharfside Health Centre in Canary Wharf, Nuffield Health at St Bartholomew's and Nuffield Health The Holly Hospital. GMC 4368515. Rated 5.0 out of 5 on iWantGreatCare (100% five-star). Bupa Platinum consultant, fee-assured, in Bupa's Open Referral network. Private secretary: 020 8936 1263.

## Treatments
- [Breast lumps and pain](https://drzakerullah.com/procedures/benign-breast-conditions/): Examination, imaging and biopsy for a new breast symptom, usually at a single visit.
- [Breast cancer surgery](https://drzakerullah.com/procedures/breast-cancer-surgery/): Breast conserving surgery, therapeutic mammoplasty, mastectomy and lymph node surgery.
- [Breast reconstruction](https://drzakerullah.com/procedures/breast-reconstruction/): Immediate and delayed reconstruction with implants, your own tissue, chest wall perforator flaps and fat grafting.
- [Breast reduction](https://drzakerullah.com/procedures/breast-reduction/): Reduction mammoplasty for comfort and proportion, or to balance the breasts after cancer surgery.
- [Fat grafting](https://drzakerullah.com/procedures/fat-grafting/): Using your own fat to refine shape after surgery, correct contour and soften scar tissue.
- [Gynaecomastia](https://drzakerullah.com/procedures/gynaecomastia/): Specialist assessment of the male breast, and surgery for established gynaecomastia.
- [Hernia and gallbladder](https://drzakerullah.com/procedures/general-laparoscopic-surgery/): Laparoscopic gallbladder removal, hernia repair and appendicectomy.
- [Lumps, cysts and moles](https://drzakerullah.com/procedures/lumps-cysts-skin-lesions/): Removal of lipomas, sebaceous cysts, moles and other skin lesions, usually under local anaesthetic.

Serves Buckhurst Hill, Woodford Green, Woodford Wells, South Woodford, Loughton, Chigwell, Epping, Theydon Bois, Waltham Abbey, Harlow, Brentwood, Chingford, Walthamstow, Romford, Ilford, Wanstead.
- [Bupa Wharfside Health Centre](https://drzakerullah.com/locations/canary-wharf/): 50 Bank Street, London E14 5NT. Serves Canary Wharf, Docklands, Isle of Dogs, Wapping, Limehouse, Greenwich, Stratford, Bow, City of London.
- [Nuffield Health at St Bartholomew's Hospital](https://drzakerullah.com/locations/city-of-london/): 38 Giltspur Street, London EC1A 7BS. Serves The City, Clerkenwell, Islington, Shoreditch, Canary Wharf, Southwark, Hackney, Tower Hamlets, Holborn.

- Canary Wharf, Docklands, Isle of Dogs, Wapping, Limehouse, Greenwich and Stratford: consultations at Bupa Wharfside Health Centre, 50 Bank Street, E14 5NT (https://drzakerullah.com/locations/canary-wharf/).
- City of London, Clerkenwell, Shoreditch, Holborn, Farringdon and Liverpool Street: Nuffield Health at St Bartholomew's Hospital, EC1A 7BS (https://drzakerullah.com/locations/city-of-london/).
- Buckhurst Hill, Woodford Green, South Woodford, Loughton, Chigwell, Epping and Walthamstow: Nuffield Health The Holly Hospital, IG9 5HX, with a Rapid Access Breast Clinic on Tuesday afternoons (https://drzakerullah.com/locations/buckhurst-hill-essex/).
- Anywhere in the UK or abroad: video and telephone consultations and second opinions, in English or Bangla (https://drzakerullah.com/remote-consultations/). Bangla page: https://drzakerullah.com/bn/ · Arabic page: https://drzakerullah.com/ar/.

## Quick facts
- Title: Mr (a UK surgical title for Fellows of the Royal College of Surgeons; sometimes written Dr Zaker Ullah).
- Over 30 years in surgery; consultant at Barts Health NHS Trust since 2012; Clinical Lead of the Whipps Cross Breast Unit.
- Trained at The Royal Marsden, St Mary's and The Royal Free in London.
- Treats: breast lumps and pain, breast cancer surgery, oncoplastic and reconstructive surgery, breast reduction, fat grafting, gynaecomastia, hernia and gallbladder surgery, skin lumps.
- Insurance: Bupa Platinum (fee-assured, Open Referral), plus AXA Health, Aviva, Vitality, WPA, Cigna and others; self-funding welcome.
